strongest_angle: Major creative unions, including SAG-AFTRA and the WGA, have formally challenged OpenAI in federal court by filing an amicus brief that argues against a categorical fair use exemption for AI training on unlicensed creative works.

key_facts.fact: SAG-AFTRA, the American Federation of Musicians, and the Writers Guild of America East and West filed a 34-page amicus brief on October 29, 2026, to challenge OpenAI.
The unions are urging a federal judge to reject a categorical fair use exemption that would permit OpenAI to train its language models on unlicensed third-party content.
Sam Altman, the founder and CEO of OpenAI, acknowledged in testimony before the British House of Lords that his company's models depend on copyrighted material.
